name: Viper-V12
source:
Yet another entry in the Viper series, Viper V-12 exploits the same format all the previous entries followed: there are three unrelated short stories which mostly consist of animated sex scenes, with some interaction here and there.

Here are the stories:

1. "Future Investigator Bravan": Bravan is a powerful warrior clad in power armor, who fights for human beings in and has only one weakness: his pretty female comrades. A group of demons called "Donar", led by the mischievous female doppelganger Colonel Gel, decide to use the shape-shifting powers of the commander to lure Bravan to their lair.

2. "Angel Dust": Two cosmic rangers attack a space pirate ship and board it, hoping to steal treasures and to become rich. But they were not careful enough when they entered the ship without any precautions: the space pirates had other plans for the young girls.

3. "Magical Gambler": A young child has a dream which becomes reality: two cute flying creatures appear in front of her and give her a magic rod. However, when the girl uses the rod, she miraculously turns into a young and sexy woman. She decides to use the powers of the rod for her own greed, and becomes the Queen of Gambling.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/43492/viper-v12/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《VIPER》系列又一部作品。《VIPER-V12》沿用歷代作品的形式，收錄三個各自獨立的短篇。內容主要由動畫性愛場景構成，其中穿插少量互動。

三個故事分別是：

1．「未來特搜佈雷班」：佈雷班身披動力裝甲，是一名為人類而戰的強大戰士，唯一弱點就是身邊漂亮的女性同伴。由狡猾的女性擬態者格爾上校率領的惡魔集團「多納爾」，決定利用上校的變身能力，把佈雷班誘入巢穴。

2．「Angel Dust」：兩名宇宙遊俠襲擊了一艘太空海盜船，登船後打算奪走財寶，一夜暴富。她們毫無防備地闖進船艙，卻不知道海盜們早已為這兩名年輕女孩另作安排。

3．「Magical Gambler」：一個年幼女孩的夢想化為現實，兩隻可愛的飛行生物出現在她面前，送給她一根魔法杖。女孩使用魔法杖後，奇蹟般地變成了一名年輕性感的女性。她決定用這股力量滿足私慾，成為稱霸賭壇的女王。
